mapper.update: UPDATE ai_hr_item_retry SET generation=generation+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND item_id=#{item} AND generation<2

UPDATE ai_hr_batch_item SET encrypted_content=#{content},filename=#{filename},content_hash=#{hash},status='PENDING',stage='MANUAL_RETRY',error_code=NULL,progress=0 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{item} AND status='FAILED'
